title: Block: Open Positions

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.name: eyebrow
fields.instructions: Optional short label above the heading.

fields.label: Introduction
fields.name: introduction
fields.instructions: Optional context about the team or hiring process.
fields.default_value: We’re looking for curious people who care about making meaningful work together.

fields.label: Heading Level
fields.name: heading_level
fields.instructions: Choose the level that fits the page hierarchy. Job titles use the next level.

fields.label: Greenhouse Board Token (Live API)
fields.name: board_token
fields.instructions: This loads live jobs from Greenhouse; it is not sample data. From your organization's main public board URL, copy the slug immediately after job-boards.greenhouse.io/. For https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/dept, enter dept. Do not use an individual job URL. The board must exist and be public. No API key is required.

fields.label: Maximum Jobs
fields.name: maximum_jobs
fields.instructions: Limit the number of roles shown in this block.

fields.label: Role Link Label
fields.name: link_label
fields.instructions: Shared action label for every role.

fields.label: No Openings Message
fields.name: empty_message
fields.instructions: Shown when the board has no published roles or cannot be reached and no cached result is available.
fields.default_value: There are no open positions right now. Please check back soon.

description: Portable fields for a Greenhouse-powered list of open positions.
